standards.title: Daily floor
standards.text: Every planned day ends with a logged artifact: solution code or closed-book answers. No artifact leaves the day empty on the strip, and tomorrow does not advance.

standards.title: Hard timers
standards.text: Easy 20 minutes, medium 35, hard 50. At the cap the hint ladder opens: pattern name, then invariant, then approach. Any hint makes the solve not independent.

standards.title: Re-solve rule
standards.text: A failed or hinted problem is re-solved cold within 48 hours and again after 7 days. Two independent passes close it.

standards.title: What independent means
standards.text: The code passes. You stated the pattern, invariant, complexity and two edge cases before running it. No hint and no AI.

standards.title: No AI in tests
standards.text: Timed solves, retests and closed-book answers are unaided. A solve done with AI is void and logged as void.

standards.title: Overdue retests block
standards.text: An overdue retest stops new material until it is passed or turned into a written remediation plan.

standards.title: Checkpoints cannot be skipped
standards.text: A failed checkpoint freezes new topics in the failed area for the following week. Remediation replaces them.

standards.title: Missed days
standards.text: No extra hours to catch up. The cut ladder applies, in its fixed order.

standards.title: Stories
standards.text: Real incidents you can verify. No metric unless you measured it.
